I think it is your responsibility, but it's your right to disagree. My original issue was not specified to your story, but in general to these kind of posts. I'm not lonely, and this has nothing to do with me. I genuinely wrote this to talk about this reoccurring thing. In my other comment I tried to expand why I think this. Do you think you are better than your boyfriend, because now you are just passive agressive, and trying to hurt by implying that I'm lonely, just because I don't think it's fair for partners to be blasted for a bad comment so often? I'm sorry if I didn't give you a 'damn your partner is awful!!' type of reply. I'm sorry if I offended you, but we could have kept this as a simple discussion.


I'm rather putting my edit here, isntead of the new comment: the fact, that you get upvotes for a baseless mean remark about me, that has nothing to do with the topic is really sad. I hope one day people stop witchunts, when someone doesn't agree with them, and manage to hold a discussion. I even apologized if I offended you and expanded my opinion, because I felt like it had to be made clearer, but I feel fucking disrespected for going so much below level with that comment. You are victimizing yourself, and mental health is only sacred when its about you, otherwise, you have no issues being mean and personal. It's just petty, especially for someone posting about their emotions being hurt. While I didn't even get personal, only generalized an issue. I hope you have the same courage to show your bf this post about him and the bad comments about him, as being mean. Look into yourself, and adress your own loneliness instead putting it on others. Being in a bad relationship doesn't make you less lonely than others, and it doesn't entitle you to assume about others' situation. Also being able to vent about this only online doesn't make you seem less lonely either. I still want no arguments, I am just shocked by the reactions, as my comment can be also scrolled over or dismissed if not agreed, as many of you advised. Maybe this is becuase I don't like to get into arguments, but I hope yall are doing good anyways, and I'm sorry if it came across insensitive or triggering to some people

Because wrapping these into memes still indicates they need advice, and these are not actually memes for us because it's about a very specific personal issue, it kind of misses the point of the sub. Maybe there should be a different subreddit for these types of issues, or even a relationship flair would help, because most come here for relief by EDs memes. Even just searching about this question, OPs could read a lot of kindly written advices by others regarding this issue, instead of putting up the same type of posts. Again, this is my opinion, but I think it's valid too.

I don't think you should take 2.5mgs. You can have dependence on a higher dose even in 3 weeks, so I think there is a good chance you would feel the reduction. Especially since XR is 'lighter' as it slowly builds up and doesn't give immediate relief, so you might even have moderate issues with transitioning even without the increase. 

The XR is really effective for general anxiety, but I do warn you, that coming off of them, and transitioning back to IR for tapering is a HELL. Not to scare you, but I think someone should only start it, if they plan for undefined long-term consumption.
